          <p class="step-lead">

            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Verification before discovery</h3>
              <p>
                Phone, email, and liveness checks before anyone appears in introductions. Badges explain what was
                verified .. they raise trust, they never guarantee behaviour.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row reverse">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">

            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Recommended public places</h3>
              <p>
                For first meets, prefer busy public spots and partner venues where available .. places with
                people around, clear hours, and a safer vibe than private or isolated spots. These are recommendations,
                not surveillance. You still choose where to go.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row">

              </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Date plan &amp; optional check-in</h3>
              <p>
                Set venue and time before you go. Check in when you arrive if you want .. so your plan is clear and a
                trusted person can know you’re okay. No continuous live tracking. No forced location trail.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

              <h3>Share Date with someone you trust</h3>
              <p>
                One tap sends venue and time to a friend or family member. They know where you planned to be .. without
                Aynera following your every move. Built for Meet, useful anytime you go offline.
              </p>

              <h3>Report &amp; block .. in-app or after</h3>
              <p>
                Report a profile, message, or offline incident in a few taps. Blocking ends contact immediately. You
                can still report after a date .. safety does not end when the chat ends.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Safety across every chapter</h3>
              <p>
                Focus and Together pause discovery .. they never remove your exits. Report, block, respectful close, and
                cooling-off stay available through Era space too. Commitment should feel safer, not locked in.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">

            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Human review when it matters</h3>
              <p>
                Automated filters help triage. Trained people handle severe cases, appeals, underage concerns, and
                offline safety reports .. so serious issues are not left to a bot alone.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div id="gathering-safety">
            <h2>Safety at Aynera Gatherings</h2>
            <p class="section-lede">
              A gathering is published only when host, venue, capacity and a safety owner are real. Verification raises confidence; it never guarantees behaviour.
            </p>
            <div class="lifecycle-grid">
              <article class="lifecycle-card">
                <h3>Host presence</h3>
                <p>A visible host, public venue, conduct expectations, and an easy report route during the gathering.</p>
              </article>
              <article class="lifecycle-card">
                <h3>Consent and contact</h3>
                <p>Photo consent before pictures. No forced pairings. No forced contact-sharing. Harassment and unwanted repeated approaches can be reported.</p>
              </article>
              <article class="lifecycle-card">
                <h3>After the gathering</h3>
                <p>Event removal when needed. Post-event reporting stays open. No continuous live tracking. Trusted-person sharing stays optional.</p>
              </article>
            </div>
          </div>

          <p class="step-note">
            Need support? <a class="text-link" href="/grievance">Contact our grievance channel</a>.
          </p>

            <a class="btn btn-plum" href="/meet">See how Meet works</a>
          </div>
